title: Hiring - Full Stack Developer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Full Stack Developer to build and maintain web applications across multiple projects. If you have strong fundamentals, love solving problems, and are eager to learn — we want to hear from you.

This role starts as a 3-month rolling contract. Based on project requirements and performance, there is a clear opportunity to transition into a permanent position — details of which will be discussed during the face-to-face interview.

What You’ll Do

* Build and maintain web applications across multiple projects
* Develop frontend features using React, Next.js, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS
* Build backend services and REST APIs using JavaScript, Node.js and Next.js
* Work with MongoDB to design data models and write efficient queries
* Implement authentication, role-based access and user permissions
* Integrate payment gateways, subscriptions, webhooks and third-party services
* Work with background workers, job queues and scheduled tasks using Redis, BullMQ and cron jobs
* Follow security best practices for APIs, user data and application access
* Debug issues, handle errors, write useful logs and test features
* Write clean, reusable code and collaborate using Git and code reviews
* Contribute to deployment, performance improvements and application scaling
* Work with AI APIs and AI coding tools

What We’re Looking For

* Strong fundamentals in JavaScript and web development
* Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* A willingness to learn and grow with the team
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks
* Good communication and collaboration skills

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote India)
description:
**Help build the open future of digital intelligence**
At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights.
  
  
Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data.
  
  
Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You’ll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you’ll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use.
  
  
Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains:
**Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform**
. You’ll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap.
  
  
You’ll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it.]
  
  
Your work will directly influence:
  
  

* The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions.
* How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them.
* How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo.
* How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale.

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like.
* Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first.
* Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems.
* Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery.
* Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them.
* Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions.
* Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it.
* Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket.
* Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites.
* The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility.
* Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment
* A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

**Helpful experience**

* You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.
* Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.
* Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business.
* Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments.
* Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software.

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact.
  
  
**Why Matomo?**
Matomo is for people who want their work to matter.
  
  
You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms.
  
  
We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next.
  
  
We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it.
  
  
High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution.
  
  
You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes.
  
  
We also protect focused work through:
  
  

* No-meeting Fridays
* No more than two days each week with late meetings
* No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant.
  
  
**Benefits**

* 100% remote working within your country of employment
* Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role
* 25 days of paid annual leave
* Home-office equipment allowance
* Health insurance support, where applicable
* Mental-health and wellbeing support
* Paid volunteering day
* Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment.
  
  
**Hiring Process**
Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)
  
  
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
Matomo values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.
  
  
**Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere.**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Cityfurnish

Cityfurnish is a Y Combinator-backed furniture and appliance rental company. Since 2015 we have helped students, families and corporate customers furnish their homes on flexible monthly subscriptions instead of buying outright. We operate across 7 Indian cities from our headquarters in Gurgaon.

Behind every rental is a lot of technology: the website and app where subscribers browse and check out, payments and auto-debit, KYC, delivery and pickup scheduling, warehouse inventory, and the service request flows that keep thousands of subscriptions running every month.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer who can own features end to end as an individual contributor: scoping, design, build, testing, deployment and support after release. You'll work across the customer-facing website and the internal tools our operations, customer support and accounts teams use every day, partnering closely with our Tech Lead on architecture and priorities. This is not a people-management role. You'll work directly with product and operations, so what you ship reaches real subscribers and real teams within days, not quarters.

We're an AI-forward team. We expect you to use AI coding tools to move faster, and to bring the engineering judgement to review, test and stand behind everything you ship.

What you'll work on

**Customer-facing platform**

•      Build and improve the Cityfurnish website using Next.js, React and TypeScript, covering product listing, cart, checkout and the subscriber account area

•      Own page speed, SEO and Core Web Vitals on a site where traffic turns directly into rentals

•      Build APIs that serve both the website and the mobile app

**Payments and integrations**

•      Build and maintain payment flows with Razorpay, including checkout, recurring auto-debit and webhook handling

•      Integrate with third-party systems such as Zoho Desk (service requests), WhatsApp and SMS notification providers, and our Odoo ERP through its APIs (orders, subscriptions, invoices and customer data)

•      Make integrations reliable: retries, idempotent webhook handling, logging and alerts when something fails

**Internal tools**

•      Build tools for inventory, warehouse operations, delivery and pickup tracking, and service request handling

•      Turn manual processes in operations, customer support and accounts into simple, reliable workflows

**Engineering quality**

•      Design REST APIs and MySQL/PostgreSQL schemas that hold up as volumes grow

•      Write tests, review code and keep the codebase easy for the next developer to work in

•      Deploy and monitor services on Azure with CI/CD pipelines

**AI in your work and in the product**

•      Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and similar) for prototyping, debugging, testing and documentation

•      Spot and build AI features that add real business value, such as smarter search, support chatbots or workflow automation

Your first 90 days

1.     
**First 30 days:**
 learn the codebase, the subscription and order lifecycle, and how teams use our systems. Ship your first fixes to production.

2.     
**By 60 days:**
 own a complete feature on the website or an internal tool, from scoping with the business team to release.

3.     
**By 90 days:**
 be the go-to person for at least one area, such as checkout and payments, an operations tool or an integration, and propose one improvement backed by data.

What you'll need

**Core engineering**

•      3–5 years of hands-on full-stack web development, with features you built running in production

•      Strong React and Next.js, including server-side rendering, static generation and SEO basics

•      TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+)

•      Node.js with Express.js for building REST APIs

•      MySQL or PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing and query optimisation

•      HTML5, CSS3 and Tailwind CSS, with an eye for responsive, usable UI

•      Experience integrating third-party APIs and webhooks; payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar) are a strong plus

•      Security basics: authentication (JWT, OAuth), handling sensitive customer and payment data, and common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)

•      Testing: unit and end-to-end tests with Jest, Playwright, Cypress or similar

•      Git and GitHub workflows, code reviews and CI/CD

•      Experience deploying and running apps on a cloud platform; Azure preferred

**AI-assisted development**

•      Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants in your workflow

•      The judgement to review, test and debug AI-generated code rather than accept it as written

•      Familiarity with calling LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar) from a web application

**How you work**

•      You own your work end to end with minimal hand-holding: you take a feature from vague business problem to shipped, monitored solution, asking the right questions along the way

•      You explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical teams

Good to have

•      Experience integrating with Odoo or another ERP through its APIs (XML-RPC/JSON-RPC or REST), including keeping data in sync between systems

•      Experience in e-commerce, subscription, rental, logistics or inventory businesses

•      Recurring payments or auto-debit mandates (UPI Autopay, eNACH)

•      WhatsApp Business API or other messaging integrations

•      Event-driven systems, queues or background job processing

•      Analytics and monitoring tools such as Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Metabase, Sentry or Grafana

•      Building with RAG, vector databases or agent workflows

•      Mobile app backends or React Native

Why join Cityfurnish

•      
**Real scale, real users:**
 your code handles live orders, payments and deliveries across 7 cities, not a demo

•      
**Breadth:**
 work across the customer website, payments, integrations and operations tools instead of one narrow corner of the stack

•      
**Short path to impact:**
 sit with the teams who use what you build, and see the result in days

•      
**AI-forward team:**
 modern AI tools are part of how we work, and you'll help bring AI features into the product

•
**Proven business:**

 YC-backed and running since 2015, with the room of a growing startup to shape how things are built

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**Description**
Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.
  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions
  
  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.
  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.
  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.
* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.
* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.
* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.
* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.
* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.
* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.
* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Web Development Support Specialist - Capstone

**execute professionally**

This role is
**hands-on, student-facing, and outcomes-driven**
.

just about building sites for students from scratch. It’s about helping students

description:

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. * Complete assigned feature sprints, conduct code reviews, and test API endpoints to ensure stability and performance.
* Optimize database queries, perform security audits of input validations, and update documentation for integrated modules to maintain system integrity.
* Successfully integrate APIs and leverage AI tools within the first 90 days to accelerate development velocity while maintaining rigorous code standards.
* Troubleshoot unforeseen API documentation errors and resolve merge conflicts or unexpected breaking changes efficiently.

What we are looking for
  
  

* At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications.
* In-depth experience with PHP and the Laravel framework for building robust applications.
* Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or any similar JavaScript framework.
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho.
* Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows.
* Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience in software development within the IT sector.
* Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

What we offer
  
  
CAD $18,000 to $30,000 per year.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Remote work flexibility
* Professional development opportunities

Schedule
  
  
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST Timezone).
  
  
What happens next
  
  
Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.
  
  
If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.
  
  
Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Full Stack MERN Developer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Full Stack MERN Developer to join our engineering team and help build and scale our pet registration platform — a production system serving pet owners, municipal workflows, and administrative operations across multiple Indian cities.

You'll own features end-to-end: from designing MongoDB schemas and Express APIs to shipping polished React interfaces. This is a hands-on role where you'll work directly with product, design, and operations to deliver real impact for pet owners and municipal partners.

Location: On-site - Saket

Experience: 0 - 2

Employment Type: Full-time

What You'll Do

Design and build full-stack features using MongoDB, Express.js, React (Next.js), and Node.js — from database schema to API endpoint to UI.

Architect clean, maintainable data models — you'll work with complex domain logic (multi-city registration workflows, document upload/verification pipelines, staged approval processes, payment integration).

Build responsive, accessible React interfaces using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and component libraries, with attention to UX details like loading states, empty states, and error handling.

Develop and maintain RESTful APIs with proper authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling.

Optimize performance — query tuning, indexing, payload sizing (we deal with base64 document storage, so you'll think carefully about what goes over the wire), and frontend rendering.

Work with file upload and document management systems — handling PDFs and images, validation, storage strategy, and secure retrieval.

Integrate third-party services — payment gateways, WhatsApp Business API, email, SMS.

Write clean, tested, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.

Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and operations to translate requirements into shipped features.

Debug production issues and continuously improve reliability and developer experience.

What We're Looking For

0 - 2 years of professional experience building full-stack web applications.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript — you write idiomatic, type-safe code and understand the tradeoffs.

Deep experience with the MERN stack:

MongoDB — schema design, Mongoose, aggregation pipelines, indexing, query optimization.

Express.js / Node.js — REST API design, middleware, authentication (JWT), error handling.

React — hooks, component architecture, state management, performance optimization.

Next.js — App Router, server/client components, routing, data fetching patterns.

Solid understanding of REST API design and how to build APIs that are predictable, versioned, and secure.

Experience with authentication and authorization — JWT, role-based access control, session management.

Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (branches, PRs, code review).

Ability to work independently — you can take a vague requirement, ask the right questions, and ship a working solution.

Nice-to-Have

TypeScript in a production codebase — not just familiarity, but real experience maintaining type-safe applications.

Tailwind CSS and component libraries (shadcn/ui, Radix, Headless UI).

Payment gateway integration - Razorpay

File/document handling — S3, Cloudinary, base64 storage tradeoffs, PDF generation.

WhatsApp Business API or similar messaging integrations.

Testing — Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, or Playwright.

Deployment experience — Vercel, Railway, Render, AWS, or similar.

Familiarity with the Indian SaaS/consumer product landscape — especially municipal or government-adjacent workflows.

What We Offer

Ownership — you'll own features end-to-end, not just tickets.

Real impact — the work you ship directly helps pet owners navigate municipal registration.

Competitive compensation with regular reviews.

A small, senior team where your voice matters and decisions are made quickly.

*be your best*

description:

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

A senior engineer is a senior role in Software Agile delivery team. The person is responsible for managing and executing the complex software modules almost independently. Additionally, the indvidual is responsible of guding and mentoring junior engineers in the team from technology standpoint.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Work with teams developing and updating enterprise applications.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Work on tasks supporting the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the technical interdependencies between stories and support Engineering Manager and Product Owner with sequencing.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of business and domain. Supports Engineering Manager and Product Owner in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule.
* Demonstrate good understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure and suggest improvements to optimize the infrastructure.
* Participate in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades working with more senior agile team members and Engineering Manager.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components with minimal support from senior team members.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, support unit testing by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/ load testing etc. through internal/ external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Follow Bain development project process and standards in completing committed tasks and modules and contribute to the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write technical documentation as required.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Contribute to the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Help and possibly lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.

**Communication (10%)**

* Ability to present the technical findings and recommendations to the leadership and Software Development team in general.
* Clearly communicates impediments to completing a story and ensures clear understanding of definition of ‘done’.
* Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during cucial conversations.

**Technical mentoring (5%)**

* Provide technical guidance to junior members. Help create a culture of transparency and sustainability.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions,
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Ability to deliver assigned module/ work with much support from senior engineers with Zero D.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/ contingencies
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree
* 5-8+ years of relevant experience

  

**Software Engineering - Technical skills:**

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core

* Languages: C#, Python, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/ Lib: React, Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Vector databases: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* GenAI & ML: Azure OpenAI, LLM integration and prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, embeddings, machine learning model development and deployment
* AI coding assistants: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions

title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Design and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies.
* Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns.
* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.
* Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design.
* Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to prototype rapidly while making clear distinctions between experimental code and production-ready solutions, including the risks and work required to transition between them.
* · Working knowledge of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, resiliency, performance, cost management, observability, and production support considerations.
* · Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain architecture choices and technical trade-offs to business leaders, subject-matter experts, architects, engineers, and risk partners.
* · Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment is beneficial.
* · Self-directed builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an evolving environment, partner constructively with enterprise IT, and balance delivery speed with reusable and supportable engineering practices

**Additional Information**

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable adjustment in relation to any of the above, please email jobs@jsheld.com and include “Applicant Adjustment” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**

J.S. Held understands all of our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely when needed
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

**EEO and Job Accommodations**

*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*

*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Staff Engineer - Salesforce/ nCino
description: About UsAt OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.About The RolenCino on Salesforce is the platform our lending teams use to originate, approve and manage commercial loans in the UK and US. As Staff Engineer you will be the technical lead for the Salesforce / nCino engineering team in Gurugram. You will own the technical direction of the platform, lead the team's most complex work hands-on, and be the main engineering contact for Lending, Credit and CRM stakeholders.What You'll Work On Integration modernisation: Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely. Platform upgrades: Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout. Production support: Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption. Regulatory change: Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs. Integrations: Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse. Data privacy and access: Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org. Standard features first: Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible. Test automation and delivery: Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments. Documentation and debt: Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components. What You Should Know 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado) Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR) Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zonesNice to have Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineeringTechWe're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment: Salesforce Platform, nCino Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events Salesforce DX, GitHub, CI/CD MuleSoft (being retired), REST APIs, Python and NodeJS services PostgreSQL, BigQuery AWS, GCP incident.io, JiraWork CultureWe expect you to work in these ways, as well as encouraging and enabling these practices from others: Collaborate - We work in cross-functional, mission driven, autonomous squads that gel over time. We pair program to work better through shared experience and knowledge. Focus on outcomes over outputs - Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. title: Staff Engineer - Salesforce/ nCino
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Role**
nCino on Salesforce is the platform our lending teams use to originate, approve and manage commercial loans in the UK and US. As Staff Engineer you will be the technical lead for the Salesforce / nCino engineering team in Gurugram. You will own the technical direction of the platform, lead the team's most complex work hands-on, and be the main engineering contact for Lending, Credit and CRM stakeholders.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Integration modernisation: Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely.
* Platform upgrades: Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout.
* Production support: Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption.
* Regulatory change: Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs.
* Integrations: Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse.
* Data privacy and access: Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org.
* Standard features first: Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible.
* Test automation and delivery: Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments.
* Documentation and debt: Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components.

What you should know
  
  

* 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce
* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code
* Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle
* Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege
* Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado)
* Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users
* Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR)
* Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs
* Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zones

Nice to have
  
  

* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications
* Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending
* Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering

Tech
  
  
We're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment:
  
  

* Salesforce Platform, nCino
* Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events
* Salesforce DX, GitHub, CI/CD
* MuleSoft (being retired), REST APIs, Python and NodeJS services
* PostgreSQL, BigQuery
* AWS, GCP
* incident.io, Jira

Work Culture
  
  
We expect you to work in these ways, as well as encouraging and enabling these practices from others:
  
  

* Collaborate - We work in cross-functional, mission driven, autonomous squads that gel over time. We pair program to work better through shared experience and knowledge.
* Focus on outcomes over outputs - Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. Measurements focused on that goal help us to understand if we are succeeding.
* Practice continuous improvement - We optimize for feedback now, rather than presume what might be needed in the future and introduce complexity before it will be used. We share learnings in blame-free formats, so that we do not repeat things that have failed, but still have confidence to innovate.
* Seek to understand our users - We constantly seek understanding from data and conversations to better serve our users' needs.
* Test outside-in, test first - TDD keeps us confident in moving fast and deploying regularly. We write scenarios first, coupling tests to behavior rather than implementation.
* You build it, you run it - We embrace DevOps culture and end-to-end ownership of products and features. Every engineer has the opportunity to lead delivery of features from start to finish.
* Embrace difference - No egos - people listen to and learn from others at all levels, with strong opinions held loosely. A wide range of voices heard to the benefit of all.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Medical cover for you, your family & parents; life and accidental cover at a multiple of your salary
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and an Employee Assistance Programme — all sponsored
* Time Off: Earned, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity & paternity leave
* Life Milestones: A financial gesture of support at marriage, childbirth, and bereavement
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave & travel, and NPS
* Growth: Professional certification support, learning & development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days
* Our Workplace: Modern central offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee — we work hard to build a culture worth showing up for

title: Full-Stack AI-Native Engineer Internship
description:

Our Gurgaon team builds the commercial, operational, and systems infrastructure behind sourcing, pricing, supplier management, catalogue growth, workflow automation, and scalable operational decision-making.

As AI reshapes how modern businesses operate, we're embedding AI-assisted software development, workflow automation, structured data systems, and operational intelligence into every function of the business.

This is a three-month paid internship,
**offering ₹40,000 per month**

. You’ll work in person with our team at our Gurugram office for the duration of the internship.

We're hiring software engineers with proven professional experience, solid engineering fundamentals, and real exposure to production environments — engineers who already build, debug, and ship using AI-assisted development as a core part of their workflow, not an experiment.

About the Role:This isn't a role for building technology in isolation. Our engineers work on systems that directly shape how the business operates, scales, and makes decisions. Most projects start with a real business problem, not a predefined technical spec — you'll work with engineering and business teams to understand a workflow, spot bottlenecks, design a solution, implement it, validate it, and keep it reliable in production.

* You'll contribute across:AI-assisted product development and internal platform engineering
* Catalogue growth systems and workflow automation
* API integrations and operational tooling
* Data quality, structured data systems, and internal dashboards/reporting
* Debugging production issues and business process optimisation
* Scalable, AI-enabled operational infrastructure

Projects typically span databases, backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and automation tooling — so we're looking for engineers who understand not just how to build a solution, but why it should be built, what it's solving, and whether it's the right call for the business.

* Who We're Looking For:Strong candidates typically bring:Experience: 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally at a recognised technology, product, SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce company, contributing to real production systems and existing codebases.
* Academic background: A strong foundation in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or a related discipline — preferably from a Tier 1 or strong Tier 2 institution.
* Engineering fundamentals: Solid backend, full-stack, or general application development skills, plus a track record of shipping useful software, automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products.
* Judgement and communication: Strong analytical thinking, high ownership and attention to detail, excellent written/verbal English, comfort in fast-moving environments, and the confidence to question assumptions rather than just execute instructions.

* This role is not for candidates whose AI experience is limited to experimenting with ChatGPT. You should already be using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar in real engineering work, and be able to:Structure prompts and context that reliably produce high-quality output
* Read, validate, and improve AI-generated code — catching bad assumptions, edge cases, and weak implementations
* Debug AI-generated code when it doesn't behave as expected
* Work within existing codebases, not just isolated personal projects
* Break down complex problems into structured implementation plans
* Use AI to move faster without outsourcing technical judgement

You should also be comfortable with standard collaborative workflows — Git/GitHub, branching, pull requests, code review, and working across shared repositories.Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs is a plus, but we don't expect mastery of every technology in our stack. What matters more is being AI-native: using AI coding assistants as a core part of how you design, build, debug, and ship — and being able to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies quickly.

Strengthen your application with: links to GitHub repos, deployed applications, a technical portfolio, open-source contributions, or other projects that demonstrate your engineering ability. For candidates with professional experience, we'll weigh most heavily what you personally built, owned, and delivered — and the decisions and trade-offs behind that work.

Business Understanding & Judgement:Babaclick is an international commerce business, and our engineering function exists to solve real commercial and operational problems. Interviews will assess business judgement alongside technical skill.

* Before interviewing, come prepared to discuss:What Babaclick does, and the markets we operate in
* Why an international commerce business needs an internal engineering function
* Where software, automation, data, and AI can create operational or commercial leverage
* How your own experience could translate into value at Babaclick

We don't expect you to understand every part of our business going in — but we do expect you to have researched it, thought critically about how it operates, and arrived with informed questions and considered views. Technical ability is essential; commercial awareness and sound judgement matter just as much.

Recruitment Process: We assess: engineering fundamentals, professional experience, AI-assisted development capability, problem-solving, ability to navigate existing codebases, communication, business judgement, and ownership.

Come prepared to discuss past systems you've worked on in depth — your individual contribution, technical decisions, trade-offs, challenges, and impact.

description:

**Description**
Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work.
