You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer-facing software that delivers on this mission.
  
  
Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership-focused role, you will still do some hands-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
  
  
You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end-to-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.

**Desirable attributes:**

* Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven, and we seek people who think in code, enjoy solving complex engineering problems, and are motivated by working closely with like-minded researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, solution delivery, and quant research enablement. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. We are looking for a hands-on technologist who enjoys building robust systems, working closely with users, and solving intellectually challenging problems. The ideal candidate is practical, curious, collaborative, and motivated by delivering tools and platforms that help researchers and investment professionals work more effectively.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Participate in the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of solutions
* Build and maintain APIs, services, tools, and platform components that enable seamless integration with front-office quant workflows.

title: Full-Stack Engineer Senior Manager, SDLC Platforms
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As the Technical Lead for SDLC platform engineering and automation, you will define the technical direction for an enterprise AI platform that transforms the software development lifecycle through intelligent automation. Working in close partnership with Product Management and engineering leaders, you will design scalable AI capabilities — including integrations across the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Forge, Atlas, Automation) and modern practices such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), event-driven architectures, and retrieval-augmented workflows — that improve developer productivity, accelerate software delivery, and strengthen engineering quality across the organization.
  
  
You will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture, establishing engineering standards, guiding implementation decisions, and mentoring engineers while driving the evolution from event-driven AI capabilities toward increasingly autonomous, multi-agent systems. You will lead architecture reviews, evaluate emerging AI technologies, and ensure platforms are secure, resilient, observable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, governance, and Responsible AI principles — balancing innovation with enterprise-grade reliability and operational excellence
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline (must have); relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership designing and delivering enterprise-scale software platforms (must have).
* Demonstrated expertise in enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent agent architectures, with experience building secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions (must have).
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, API-first design, and event-driven architectures across Azure and AWS; experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, MCP, and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel
* Experience integrating modern engineering platforms and DevSecOps ecosystems, including Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, Forge, Atlas, Automation) and CI/CD pipelines; proven ability to influence technical direction and mentor engineers (preferred).

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering organization focused on transforming the software development lifecycle through AI-driven automation. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and DevSecOps teams to design and deliver scalable AI capabilities, and will engage regularly with engineering leaders, architects, and technical specialists to establish standards, evolve platform capabilities, and drive adoption of modern AI engineering practices.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Performing and managing rigorous, logical, and accurate analysis of complex AI architecture and platform challenges — identifying and framing complex problems, addressing root causes, and drawing out innovative insights rather than surface-level fixes.
* Writing clear and concise communications and leading conversations and meetings effectively — modulating your style to audience and context, actively listening, and driving to conclusions based on data and expertise to influence engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Structuring, planning, and prioritizing complex technical work; anticipating and managing changing priorities while managing and delivering high-quality output that is mindful of impact on the broader business.
* Partnering effectively with diverse teams and networks — Product Management, Platform Engineering, Security, and DevSecOps — while coaching engineers, creating opportunities for their development, and striking the right balance between empowerment and managerial direction.
* Embracing change with adaptability and agility, bringing curiosity and creativity to continually evolve how the team works, while performing with the highest level of integrity and a growth mindset that generates trust across the organization.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

As a member of the team, you will get to work on the firm’s analytical portfolio, risk management, and optimization engine for most of the discretionary strategies. The team focuses on making all this functionality available in real time by reengineering the current architecture and design. The team also supports our quant, portfolio managers, and traders’ requirements by adding necessary support to the engine and building various tools.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
As a member of the team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex financial trading systems that process large volumes of data customized to different business groups, focusing on scalability, reusability, performance, efficiency, and fault tolerance. You will also review and implement complex design and code that meets the requirements of multiple stakeholders. In this role, you will need to understand the complexities of multi-threaded and multi-forked systems that cater to ever-changing business needs and balance the long-term “big picture” and short-term implications of design decisions. Additionally, you will need to understand the product and project management space and plan roadmaps and deliverables in a manner that maximizes business capabilities. You will further be responsible for coaching, guiding, and mentoring various engineers working across different efforts by providing oversight and direction.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or any related discipline with 7 to 13 years of core software development experience
* Exceptional computer science fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, databases, operating systems, etc.
* Expertise in designing and developing complex systems and the ability to translate a vague high-level requirement into a well-structured and coherent system design and to build LLD, mentor juniors, and conduct solid code reviews
* Proven problem-solving skills and robust knowledge of data structures and algorithms
* Excellent hands-on development skills in prototype technical solutions
* The ability to mentor and coach junior team members
* The ability to work with a diverse set of stakeholders, bring in the right prioritizations and deliver to the dynamically changing requirements
* Extensive hands-on experience in building multithreaded systems using C++ and Python
* Excellent technical communication skills

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience working in the finance domain
* Mentoring or people management experience

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LdTechjshMar2025
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers.

title: Experienced Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
Join Ericsson as an Experienced Architect for CBEV Biller TPG, focused on Invoicing (INV) and Finance (FIN). Bring senior Java engineering and software architecture expertise to a business-critical telecom BSS product. You will translate business and product needs into robust, secure, scalable software designs; guide teams from specification through implementation and verification; and help evolve Biller capabilities for production-grade operator environments. Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and responsible AI-native software development are expected parts of the engineering approach.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own and evolve CBEV Biller architecture, especially INV and FIN; translate business needs and non-functional requirements into solution designs, service boundaries, interfaces, data models, and architecture decisions.
* Design modular distributed services and BSS integrations using APIs and messaging; address availability, scalability, performance, security, resilience, data consistency, observability, and operational support.
* Provide hands-on Java leadership: guide implementation, review code and designs, solve complex issues, improve quality, and coach engineers.
* Promote automated testing, secure development, clean code, CI/CD, performance analysis, and production readiness; manage technical risks and debt.
* Drive Spec-Driven Development (SDD), linking requirements and specifications to design, code, tests, and acceptance evidence. Use approved AI coding tools and agents with effective prompts and human review, protecting security, privacy, and code integrity.
* Guide invoice flows including bill cycles and runs, periodic and on-demand billing, invoice generation and formatting, charges, taxes, discounts, enquiries, and corrections.
* Guide finance flows including customer accounts and receivables, invoice/payment posting, payment allocation, balances, adjustments, deposits, refunds, reversals, transfers, write-offs, reconciliation, and accounting export.
* Protect financial correctness, auditability, and data integrity through robust transaction handling, retries, recovery, and reconciliation; collaborate across product, development, verification, and operations teams.

**What You Will Bring**

* 10 to 15 years of hands-on Java development, with demonstrated technical leadership and architecture responsibility appropriate to an experienced architect role.
* Strong Java and object-oriented design: advanced language concepts, concurrency, patterns, debugging, profiling, performance, and secure coding.
* Experience with Spring/Spring Boot, microservices, REST/SOAP, Hibernate or similar persistence, and data modelling.
* Ability to design distributed systems, APIs, and synchronous/asynchronous integrations; experience with cloud-native delivery, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitOps.
* Quality-first mindset with Java test automation and unit, integration, and end-to-end testing experience.
* Practical experience with generative AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot or Claude), AI agents, and prompt engineering; familiarity with SDD workflows and documentation.
* Strong BSS and telecom billing knowledge, with depth in both Invoicing and Finance. CBEV/BEAM or comparable BSS, billing, and accounting integrations are an advantage.
* Kafka, Cassandra, and full-stack troubleshooting across UI, services, and APIs are beneficial. Bring clear communication, ownership, mentoring, Agile collaboration, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience.

**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**
**Why join Ericsson?**
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Senior Specialist, Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The Full Stack AI Engineer is a senior member of Amplify Health’s Technology team, responsible for designing, building and operating secure, production-grade applications within Claims Pro. Claims Pro supports the end-to-end claims value chain, from provider management and eligibility through claims adjudication and payment, through configurable, white-label B2B capabilities that can be adapted to customer and market requirements across Asia, supporting payers, providers, employers and members. The role combines strong full-stack engineering with practical AI delivery, building React and TypeScript front ends in an Nx/Vite workspace, Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs and PostgreSQL-backed data layers, while integrating enterprise AI services, LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing and responsible AI controls into relevant claims workflows. Working closely with Product, Design, architecture, data, DevOps, security and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will translate regulated business and operational requirements and high-value AI opportunities into reliable, scalable, secure, auditable and measurable software capabilities, supporting API-first integrations, healthcare and payer data interoperability, and reliable claims workflows across customers and markets.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Build Full-Stack AI-Enabled Products**

* Design, build, and deploy full-stack AI-enabled applications for Claims Pro using React, TypeScript, Nx and Vite for responsive front-end experiences, and Java/Spring Boot services for secure back-end APIs, workflow integrations and production deployments, supporting configurable capabilities across provider management, eligibility, claims adjudication and payment in line with agreed product requirements.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces, dashboards, conversational experiences, and document-based workflows that embed AI capabilities into real business processes while maintaining accessibility, performance and usability standards.
* Build scalable back-end services, API-first REST APIs, integration layers and PostgreSQL-backed data access patterns using SQL, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC and Flyway to connect AI services and Claims Pro workflows with payer, provider and healthcare systems, using HL7 FHIR and SMART on FHIR interoperability and secure access patterns where applicable.
* Partner with Product, Design, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate claims business and operational requirements and relevant AI opportunities into useful, trusted, secure and measurable product features that can be configured for customer and market needs.

**2) Design and Develop Generative AI, RAG & Agentic Solutions**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI applications using enterprise foundation models and AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or equivalent platforms.
* Build RAG solutions using embeddings, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge sources, secure retrieval patterns, evaluation controls and auditable data access.
* Develop AI agents, copilots, chatbots, and intelligent automation flows that support user productivity, decision support and operational efficiency within governed product workflows.
* Engineer prompts, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks and guardrails to improve model quality, reliability, traceability, safety and business relevance.

**3) Implement Intelligent Document Processing & AI Services**

* Develop document processing solutions using OCR, Azure Document Intelligence, and other AI services to extract, classify, validate, and transform structured and unstructured information.
* Design human-in-the-loop review, feedback, and validation workflows to improve accuracy, explainability, auditability and user trust in AI outputs.
* Integrate AI capabilities such as language understanding, vision, speech, translation, content moderation and analytics into product and business applications where relevant.
* Design secure healthcare and payer data pipelines, schema migrations, validation and data-quality controls, and monitoring patterns to support AI retrieval, analytics, quality measurement and continuous improvement, including bulk data processing and near-real-time claims workflows where required by product requirements.

**4) Deliver Production-Grade Engineering, Cloud Operations & Governance**

* Move AI use cases from prototype to production through robust software engineering practices, including automated testing with Jest/Testing Library and JUnit/Spring Boot testing, code review, CI/CD, release management, monitoring, logging and operational support, embedding privacy, security, performance and observability into development and testing.
* Design secure, scalable and cost-effective cloud-native architectures on Azure or other cloud environments, considering cloud-agnostic service design where appropriate, with observability, performance, latency, configuration, dependency and cost controls to support reliable Claims Pro services and integrations.
* Implement OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication and authorization, secure APIs, sensitive-data handling, Responsible AI, privacy-by-design, auditability, compliance and governance controls suitable for healthcare, financial and insurance systems, aligned with applicable market regulations and secure exchange of healthcare and payer data.
* Monitor application and AI solution quality, reliability, hallucination risk, model performance, user feedback and business impact; support post-launch monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement of Claims Pro applications and mission-critical B2B integrations based on evidence.

**5) Drive Innovation, Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Enablement**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI opportunities in partnership with Product, business, data, security, architecture, DevOps and engineering stakeholders.
* Provide technical recommendations on AI architecture, full-stack engineering patterns, cloud services, security controls, model selection, tooling and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Conduct targeted POCs and pilots with a clear path to production, including success metrics, adoption considerations, operational readiness, scaling plans and risk controls.
* Mentor engineers and stay current with advancements in full-stack engineering, GenAI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, LLM frameworks and healthcare technology trends, translating relevant developments into practical business value.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial end-to-end ownership of production full-stack applications across front-end, back-end, APIs, data layers, cloud services and operations.
* 2+ years of practical experience building AI, GenAI, LLM, RAG, intelligent automation or data-driven applications, preferably in enterprise or regulated environments.
* Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and React, including component architecture, routing, state management, forms, schema validation, frontend performance and accessibility, with hands-on experience in Nx and Vite preferred.
* Strong Java and Spring Boot experience building secure REST services, with practical knowledge of validation, exception handling, OpenAPI documentation and service-layer design.
* Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including experience with JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, schema migrations, transaction management and query optimisation.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into user-facing products, workflows, dashboards, conversational interfaces, document-processing journeys or operational tools.
* Practical experience with foundation models and enterprise AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or equivalent platforms.
* Experience implementing RAG solutions using embeddings, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge sources, and appropriate retrieval and evaluation patterns.
* Experience moving software or AI solutions from prototype to production using engineering practices such as automated testing, code review, Git, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, release management and operational support.
* Experience with OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication and authorization, secure coding, API integration and common application security practices.
* Required: hands-on experience in financial services, insurance, healthcare or other regulated data environments, with a strong understanding of sensitive data, security, auditability and operational controls.
* Preferred: experience with health insurance claims workflows, provider management, eligibility, adjudication or payment, and healthcare or payer system integrations, including HL7 FHIR and SMART on FHIR where applicable.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Design, business, data, security, DevOps and engineering stakeholders, translating business needs into pragmatic, reliable and measurable technical solutions.

**Competencies & Core Characteristics:**

We are seeking a senior Full Stack AI Engineer who is a strong production software engineer first, with the practical AI delivery experience needed to embed GenAI, RAG, intelligent document processing, evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI capabilities into secure Claims Pro applications and healthcare and insurance workflows.

**Technical Domain Expertise**

Possesses deep full-stack engineering capability across React, TypeScript, Java/Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, cloud-native services, automated testing, CI/CD and production operations, with practical expertise in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, intelligent document processing, evaluation and responsible AI engineering.

**Strategic Architect**

Able to design scalable, secure and maintainable full-stack AI solutions for configurable Claims Pro capabilities aligned with business objectives and regulated-domain requirements. Balances innovation with pragmatic implementation considerations including user experience, API-first design, healthcare and payer interoperability, data architecture, cost, performance, privacy-by-design, auditability, governance, maintainability and operational readiness across customers and markets.

**Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer**

Collaborates effectively across Product, Design, engineering, architecture, data, security, DevOps, operations and business teams. Influences stakeholders through technical credibility, communicates complex full-stack and AI concepts clearly, and helps align solution choices with product value, delivery feasibility and responsible-use controls.

**Data-Driven Decisiveness**

Uses quantitative metrics, experimentation, model and retrieval evaluations, observability signals, production telemetry and operational insights to guide decisions. Continuously measures product quality, AI output reliability, hallucination risk, user adoption, performance and business impact, and drives improvements based on evidence.

**Customer-Obsessed Advocate**

Maintains a strong focus on delivering meaningful customer, user and business impact through Claims Pro. Designs configurable AI-enabled claims experiences and reliable payer and provider integrations that address customer and market requirements, improving productivity, accuracy, decision support, workflow efficiency and value realization while preserving trust, transparency and responsible use.

**Resilient Operator**

Thrives in rapidly evolving technology environments and adapts quickly to changing priorities. Demonstrates end-to-end ownership, accountability and persistence across design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement of complex full-stack and AI-enabled systems.

**Insatiable Curiosity**

Continuously explores emerging full-stack engineering practices, cloud-native services, AI models, RAG patterns, agentic workflows, evaluation techniques and responsible AI controls. Challenges conventional approaches and actively identifies practical opportunities for innovation, automation and competitive advantage.

**Preferred Technical Skills Matrix**

**Must Have**

* Production full-stack software engineering across front end, back end, APIs, data layer and operations
* React, TypeScript, component architecture, routing, state management, forms, schema validation, accessibility and frontend performance
* Nx and Vite workspace development, reusable library boundaries, npm dependency management and modern frontend build practices
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OpenAPI documentation, validation, exception handling and service-layer design
* PostgreSQL, SQL, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, Flyway, schema migrations, transaction management and query optimisation
* OAuth2/OIDC authentication and authorization, Auth0-style patterns, secure API design, secure coding and sensitive-data handling
* Automated testing, code review and quality gates using Jest/Testing Library, JUnit/Spring Boot testing or equivalent tools
* Git, npm, Gradle, CI/CD, release automation, monitoring, logging, observability and production support
* LLM API and enterprise AI service integration, including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or equivalent foundation model platforms
* RAG architecture, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, secure retrieval, retrieval evaluation and enterprise knowledge integration
* AI application integration into user-facing products, dashboards, conversational interfaces, document workflows and operational tools
* Responsible AI, data privacy, application security, auditability, governance, prompt/data handling controls and model-output risk management
* Financial services, insurance, healthcare or other regulated data environment experience

**Good to Have**

* Azure cloud-native services including Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Functions, App Services, Container Apps, Storage and Key Vault
* AWS or GCP cloud-native architecture, managed services, observability, performance engineering and cost-aware production operations
* Docker, Jib, Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms for packaging, deployment and operational readiness
* Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude or other foundation model platforms beyond OpenAI/Azure OpenAI
* LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or equivalent LLM orchestration and agent frameworks
* AI agents, copilots, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems and workflow automation patterns
* OCR, intelligent document processing, extraction/classification pipelines and human-in-the-loop validation workflows
* MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, AI observability, prompt/version management, experimentation and production monitoring practices
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, ontology design and enterprise knowledge management platforms
* Multimodal AI capabilities including vision, speech, translation, video, content moderation and document understanding
* Power Platform AI integration, workflow automation and low-code/no-code enablement for business users
* Domain experience with health insurance, claims, provider management, care management, healthcare analytics or other data-intensive financial products
* HL7 FHIR, SMART on FHIR, healthcare and payer system interoperability, and secure API-first integration patterns
* Bulk data processing and near-real-time integration patterns for healthcare, payer and claims workflows

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal, Tech (GAITech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
  
  
UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with very large distributed systems
* Knowledge of design process
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Application Architect
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build high-performance, stateless REST APIs using asynchronous and event-driven patterns for high-volume, low-latency interactions.
* Design decoupled microservices communicating through message queues, event buses, or streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Pulsar.

* Own API lifecycle and contract management, including backward compatibility, schema versioning,

pagination, partial updates, and modular validation

* 8 – 11 years of experience designing, building, and operating distributed, asynchronous systems and production-grade applications.
* Strong expertise in REST, gRPC, microservices, message-driven systems, and event-driven architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Go, Rust, and/or Python, with experience deploying microservices on Kubernetes or ECS.
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, DynamoDB, or comparable low-latency storage and caching technologies.

* Strong understanding of Docker, CI/CD, DevOps practices, Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools, and functional, reactive, and concurrent programming.

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.
  
  
With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
* Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
* Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
* Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
* Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
* Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
* Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
* Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
* Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
* Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
* Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification strongly preferred; additional certifications such as JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect are a plus
* Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
* In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Description**
