* Degree Type: BTech, B.E
* Major Specialization: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
* CGPA: 80% in the last semester OR CGPA of 8 on a scale of 10 in the last semester with no pending backlogs

**Certifications:**
Good to have if any
  
  
**Work Experience:**
No work experience, freshers only
  
  
**Foundational skills:**
Hands-on engagement in the full software lifecycle activities is expected. This includes requirements analysis, coding, testing, and deployment. Job expectations include a strong knowledge of development and testing practices common to the industry and design patterns that supports complex applications.
  
  

* Fundamental knowledge and understanding of programming languages, data visualization tools, application frameworks, distributed systems and databases.
* Basic proficiency in atleast one of the following programming languages: Java, C#/.NET, C++, Python.
* Experience in Agile methodology, Process Improvement, Excel, JIRA. Knowledge of Linux/Unix
* Ability to deal with ambiguity, including various work assignments and changing priorities
* Strong influencing skills with the ability to influence both vertically and horizontally
* Assertiveness, initiative, strong work ethic and a team attitude
* Distinguished written and oral communications skills
* Candidates should possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, a drive for excellence, and a commitment to achieving sustainable results. Additionally, students should hold strong academic and technical skills in Microsoft Office.

**Desired Skills:**

* Good to have experience with developing frameworks and tools specific to AI/ML applications.
* Good to have familiarity with cloud platforms and development in cloud environments.
* Candidate good at problem solving and have quantitative skills
* Can implement solutions based on requirements or based on one’s own innovative ideas
* Have the willingness and aptitude to work in global distributed teams
* Have attention to detail and strong work ethics

**Other Campus Eligibility Requirements:**
Students with Indian citizenship and residing in India
  
  
Students should be open for any roles that they are finally selected as they deem suitable in the interview/evaluation process

title: Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications)
description:
**Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications)**

**Role Summary**

The Full Stack Developer will design, build and deploy secure, scalable web applications with integrated AI and machine learning capabilities. The role requires strong full-stack engineering across frontend, backend, data and cloud layers, together with practical AI/ML engineering competence: integrating models across commercial, cloud and self-hosted providers, building retrieval and agent workflows, and adapting and serving models where required.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech., MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML or a related discipline
  **(Must have)**
* Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight
* Candidates with strong verifiable work (production applications or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification

**Experience**

* 4+ years of professional full-stack development (5+ years preferred);
  **minimum 2 years building and deploying AI- or ML-powered features in production applications**
* Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least one production web application, covering frontend, backend, database, deployment and monitoring
* **Demonstrable experience delivering at least one LLM or ML-powered application to end users**
  (such as a retrieval-augmented assistant, a document-processing workflow or an agent), including its evaluation and monitoring
* Hands-on experience with Python and TypeScript in production, and with React-based frontends
* Experience deploying containerised applications on cloud platforms through CI/CD pipelines
* Experience fine-tuning or self-hosting models, working in regulated sectors, or building Indian-language applications is a plus

**Key Responsibilities**

Application Development

* Design and develop responsive, accessible web applications using React and Next.js with TypeScript
* Develop backend services and APIs in Python (FastAPI) and Node.js, with clear contracts (OpenAPI or GraphQL) and versioning
* Design data models and optimise queries across relational and NoSQL databases, and implement caching and background job processing
* Translate functional requirements into well-structured, maintainable and production-ready code

AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate LLMs in a provider-agnostic manner across commercial APIs, cloud AI platforms and self-hosted open-weight models, through an abstraction or gateway layer, so that models can be switched or compared without application changes
* Build LLM-powered features, including streaming conversational interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation with source citations, structured extraction and tool-calling agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Implement retrieval pipelines covering document ingestion and parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid vector search and re-ranking
* Implement routing, caching, rate limiting and fallbacks across providers to control quality, cost and latency

Model Integration & Serving

* Integrate and serve pre-trained models (such as OCR, speech, classification and embedding models, including Indic language models) behind production APIs
* Fine-tune or adapt models where required (for example, LoRA fine-tuning of an LLM or embedding model), in coordination with data scientists
* Build evaluation suites for AI features (golden datasets, regression tests and LLM-based evaluation) and run them in CI as release gates

Security, Privacy & Responsible AI

* Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and role-based access control), and secure handling of APIs, secrets and personal data
* Apply OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications controls, including defences against prompt injection and data leakage
* Apply data-minimisation practices in compliance with applicable data protection law, including for data sent to external model providers, and design human review for consequential AI outputs

Quality, Deployment & Operations

* Practise test-driven development with unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and maintain adequate coverage
* Containerise applications and manage deployments through CI/CD pipelines on Kubernetes or serverless platforms, using infrastructure as code
* Instrument applications with logging, metrics and tracing, including LLM traces, token usage and cost, and participate in incident resolution
* Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 and GIGW) and support for Indian languages in user interfaces

Collaboration & Mentoring

* Participate in Agile delivery, code reviews and architecture discussions
* Mentor junior developers, and document designs, APIs and operational runbooks

Technical Competencies

* **Frontend:**
  TypeScript, React, Next.js (App Router and server components), Tailwind CSS, component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent), TanStack Query; accessibility and internationalisation
* **Backend:**
  Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio) and Node.js (NestJS, Fastify or Express); REST with OpenAPI, GraphQL; WebSockets and server-sent events for streaming; background jobs (Celery or BullMQ)
* **Databases & Caching:**
  PostgreSQL (with pgvector), MongoDB, Redis; ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Prisma or Drizzle); schema migrations and query optimisation
* **LLM Providers & Frameworks:**
  commercial APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini), cloud AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI), Indian providers (Sarvam, Bhashini) and self-hosted open-weight models via vLLM or Ollama; gateways such as LiteLLM; LangGraph, LlamaIndex or equivalent multi-provider frameworks; structured outputs, tool calling and MCP
* **Retrieval & Vector Search:**
  embeddings, chunking strategies, hybrid search and re-ranking; vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus or Weaviate); document parsing (Docling or vision-language OCR models)
* **Applied ML:**
  PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers for inference and fine-tuning (PEFT); scikit-learn; ONNX Runtime and quantised models; pre-trained models for OCR, speech (IndicConformer, Whisper) and Indic NLP (AI4Bharat)
* **AI Evaluation & Observability:**
  promptfoo, DeepEval or RAGAS in CI; MLflow; Langfuse or Arize Phoenix; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana
* **Security:**
  OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, Keycloak or equivalent identity providers; OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications; secrets management; guardrails for LLM inputs and outputs
* **Testing, DevOps & Cloud:**
  pytest, Vitest or Jest, Playwright; Git, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes and Helm, Terraform; AWS, Azure or GCP managed services
* **Data Pipelines (desirable):**
  Airflow or Dagster; Kafka or other message queues

**Please note this is a contractual role and its completely work form office at Delhi location**

title: Full Stack AI Engineering Lead
description:
**About Bloom AI**

Bloom AI builds
**AI-native intelligence systems and workflows**
for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions. We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations build systems that continuously understand context, generate intelligence and support action. Our model sits between traditional product companies and services firms. We build reusable technology and engineering patterns while deploying them against real enterprise problems and adapting them to different client environments.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR). This is a hybrid role.

**The Role**

We are looking for a
**hands-on Full Stack AI Engineer with 4–6 years of experience**
who can design, build and deploy production-grade AI applications, with particular emphasis on
**multi-agent systems, backend engineering and end-to-end application development**
.

This is a core engineering role for someone who combines strong software fundamentals with practical experience building LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows and intelligent data systems.

You should be comfortable working across the stack—from building agent orchestration and backend services to developing user-facing applications, integrating enterprise data and deploying solutions in cloud environments.

This is
**not a prompt-engineering or research-only role**
. We are looking for someone who can turn AI capabilities into reliable, scalable software that solves real business problems.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment. You will be part of core team reporting to the CEO.

**What You'll Do**

**Build Agentic Systems**

* Design and develop multi-agent systems that coordinate specialized agents to execute complex tasks and workflows.
* Implement agent orchestration, planning, tool calling, task delegation, context management and state management.
* Build LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar**
  .
* Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, agent memory and knowledge retrieval capabilities.
* Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, databases, documents and external data sources.
* Implement evaluation, tracing, error handling, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Build Backend and Full Stack Applications**

* Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs and application logic using
  **Python and frameworks such as FastAPI**
  .
* Build user-facing applications using modern frontend frameworks such as
  **React, Next.js or similar**
  .
* Develop data models, database integrations and processing pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
* Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and integrations between application components.
* Design modular, maintainable architectures that support reuse across client environments.
* Own features end-to-end, including technical design, development, testing, integration and deployment.

**Work with Graph and Context Systems**

* Design data structures and retrieval mechanisms that help AI systems understand entities, relationships and context.
* Work with graph-based data models and knowledge graphs to represent relationships across enterprise and external data.
* Combine structured data, semantic search and graph-based retrieval to support richer agent reasoning and intelligence workflows.
* Contribute to the development of persistent context, memory and state-management capabilities for AI agents.
* Evaluate when relational databases, vector databases or graph-based approaches are appropriate for different problems.

**Deploy Production Grade Systems**

* Deploy and manage applications on cloud infrastructure, preferably
  **Microsoft Azure**
  , with AWS or GCP experience also relevant.
* Work with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, model APIs and enterprise AI services.
* Implement containerization, CI/CD, authentication, logging and application monitoring.
* Build systems with appropriate security, access controls, data privacy and reliability standards.
* Debug performance, integration and production issues across the full application stack.

**Solve Real Enterprise Problems**

* Work with business and technical teams to understand workflows and translate requirements into working AI solutions.
* Rapidly prototype new capabilities, evaluate technical approaches and move successful prototypes into production.
* Integrate AI systems with existing enterprise applications, data sources and workflows.
* Collaborate with engineers to improve architecture, code quality and reusable components.
* Participate in client discussions, technical demonstrations and solution design.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4–6 years of professional software engineering experience**
  , including hands-on development of AI/LLM applications.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , backend engineering, API development and software architecture.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbot or prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar**
  .
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Experience developing full-stack applications, including working knowledge of
  **React, Next.js or another modern frontend framework**
  .
* Strong SQL, database design and data integration fundamentals.
* Working understanding of graph data structures, entity-relationship modeling and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking applications from development through testing and production deployment.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging and independent execution skills.

**Good to Have**

* Start-up or 0->1 experience.
* Experience with
  **Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or other graph databases**
  , including knowledge graph construction, Cypher and GraphRAG.
* Experience building stateful agents, long-running workflows, persistent memory or context-management systems.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation, observability and tracing tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or similar.
* Experience with
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
  , event-driven architectures, queues or distributed systems.
* Experience integrating AI into enterprise applications such as CRM, marketing, sales or research workflows.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients or in a fast-moving startup environment.

title: Automation Specialist
description:
**Company:**
Trikuta Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:**
IT / Business Automation

**Experience:**
3–5 years preferred

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Work Mode:**
As per company requirements

About the Role

Trikuta Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a hands-on Zoho Automation & Integration Developer with strong expertise in advanced Deluge scripting, custom function development, REST APIs, WhatsApp Business API, and omnichannel integrations.

The role focuses on developing custom code, integrating applications, automating workflows, and building a connected customer lifecycle automation ecosystem using Zoho CRM, Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Sign, and third-party platforms.

**This is a development-focused role, not a basic CRM administration position. Advanced Deluge scripting, API integration, and WhatsApp automation are mandatory.**

Key Responsibilities1. Advanced Deluge Scripting & Custom Development

* Develop advanced Deluge scripts, custom functions, reusable components, and scheduled functions.
* Build custom business logic, conditional workflows, event triggers, and multi-step automations.
* Automate record creation, updates, data validation, notifications, and cross-module operations.
* Develop custom solutions beyond standard Zoho workflow capabilities.
* Implement error handling, execution logs, retry mechanisms, duplicate prevention, and failure alerts.
* Debug and optimize scripts for reliability, execution limits, and API consumption.

2. Zoho CRM Custom Development

* Customize CRM modules, fields, layouts, relationships, validation rules, and record structures.
* Develop workflows, Blueprints, custom modules, scheduled actions, and approval automations.
* Build custom functions, buttons, widgets, and integrations where required.
* Automate record assignments, task creation, follow-ups, escalations, and status synchronization.
* Maintain data integrity and optimize CRM automation performance.

3. REST APIs & Third-Party Integrations

* Develop integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth 2.0.
* Connect Zoho CRM with external applications, websites, lead sources, and communication platforms.
* Build inbound/outbound data synchronization and event-driven integrations.
* Handle API authentication, pagination, rate limits, token refresh, and synchronization conflicts.
* Test APIs using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Implement logging, retries, error handling, and secure credential management.

4. Zoho WorkDrive & Zoho Sign

* Integrate Zoho CRM with Zoho WorkDrive and Zoho Sign through supported APIs and custom functions.
* Automate customer-folder creation, document organization, uploads, and permissions.
* Generate and send agreements using approved templates and CRM data.
* Synchronize document references, signature status, and completion dates with CRM.
* Handle failed uploads, expired agreements, incomplete transactions, and integration errors.

5. WhatsApp Business API Automation

* Integrate Zoho CRM with the WhatsApp Business Platform or approved solution providers.
* Develop API-based messaging functions and webhook handlers.
* Automate personalized messages, approved templates, appointment reminders, follow-ups, onboarding notifications, and customer updates.
* Process inbound messages and link customer responses to the correct CRM records.
* Handle message delivery statuses, failures, and supported interactive responses.
* Automate task creation, callback assignment, routing, and escalation based on incoming messages.
* Implement consent checks, opt-out handling, and WhatsApp policy compliance.

6. Omnichannel Integrations

* Integrate email, SMS, telephony, website chat, and other supported communication channels.
* Work with platforms such as Zoho SalesIQ, Zoho Desk, Zoho Voice, and third-party providers.
* Automate call logging, missed-call alerts, callback scheduling, IVR events, and communication follow-ups where supported.
* Synchronize communication history with CRM records.
* Develop routing rules, notifications, escalation logic, and duplicate-message prevention.

7. Workflow Engineering & Automation

* Develop event-driven, scheduled, and multi-step automation workflows.
* Connect CRM, WorkDrive, Sign, WhatsApp, email, telephony, and external applications.
* Automate lead capture, assignments, agreements, document collection, onboarding, task allocation, and case updates.
* Implement workflow sequencing, conditional triggers, failure recovery, and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Reduce manual work through custom functions, integrations, and automated data processing.

8. Testing, Debugging & Maintenance

* Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Troubleshoot Deluge scripts, API responses, webhook payloads, and synchronization failures.
* Test missing data, duplicate events, invalid inputs, and partial failures.
* Monitor API consumption, execution limits, failed workflows, and integration health.
* Maintain technical documentation, audit trails, security controls, and recovery procedures.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Advanced Zoho Deluge scripting and custom function development.
* Zoho CRM customization, workflows, Blueprints, and scheduled functions.
* REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and API authentication.
* Zoho WorkDrive and Zoho Sign integrations.
* WhatsApp Business API or an approved WhatsApp integration provider.
* Custom messaging automation and webhook-based event processing.
* Data synchronization, debugging, exception handling, and retry mechanisms.
* API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Secure credential handling and role-based access controls.

Preferred Skills

* JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and custom widget development.
* Zoho Flow, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, and Zoho Voice.
* Node.js, Python, or other languages for middleware development.
* Telephony APIs, IVR, call logging, and call disposition automation.
* AI chatbot integrations and conversational automation.
* Git or equivalent version-control systems.
* Experience in BPO, CRM-based service businesses, or customer operations.

Practical Technical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to demonstrate a working solution involving:

1. A custom Deluge function for CRM record creation and updates.
2. REST API integration and webhook-based event processing.
3. WhatsApp message delivery and inbound response synchronization.
4. Automated WorkDrive folder creation.
5. Zoho Sign agreement generation and status updates.
6. Scheduled reminders and automated task assignments.
7. Error handling, retries, duplicate prevention, and execution logging.

Candidates must explain their code, integration architecture, authentication, debugging approach, and security controls.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three to five years of relevant development experience preferred.
* Demonstrable experience with Zoho CRM development, custom functions, and API integrations.
* Ability to independently develop, test, debug, and maintain production automations.
* Strong programming, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated on code quality, successful integration delivery, automation reliability, reduction in manual work, data synchronization accuracy, failure resolution, security, and technical documentation.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**developer first, Zoho specialist second**
—someone capable of writing custom code, building API integrations, automating WhatsApp communications, and solving complex technical challenges independently.

Candidates whose experience is limited to CRM data entry, basic workflow configuration, or user administration will not be suitable.

How to Apply

Submit your updated CV with details of your Zoho CRM development projects, Deluge scripts, API integrations, WhatsApp automation experience, and Zoho WorkDrive/Sign implementations.

description: Company OverviewKKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform — spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer — and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. Set technical direction for entity mastering — standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage — designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution. Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration. Drive the platform’s storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation. Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains. Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm’s data strategy. Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform. Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap.Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms. Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks. Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems — entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage. Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale. Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, CDC). Strong command of modern data storage — relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) — and SQL. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD). Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry — parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts — and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it. Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling. Practical experience applying Generative AI / LLMs to data platforms — e.g., grounded retrieval over governed data, entity-resolution and data-quality assistance, or AI/agent-ready data access with provenance guarantees. A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers. Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders.Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with bitemporal / point-in-time data modeling and governed, auditable data systems. title: AI Harness Engineer
description:
We're hiring an experienced AI-native engineer to build the core systems behind Diligent's AI agents. This is not a prompt-writing role. This is a software engineering role for someone who can design reliable AI systems: prompts, context, tools, evals, orchestration, memory, observability, and production workflows.

**About Us**

Diligent is the new venture from the founding team of Leverage Edu, a Series D edtech company. There, our founders built and scaled multiple businesses from zero, including student mobility, cross-border payments and student housing.

Diligent is building the AI growth team every business deserves. Instead of hiring an agency or a five-person marketing team, our clients get a squad of AI agents that research competitors, plan budgets, generate creatives, and run and optimise campaigns on Meta and Google, with senior marketers guiding every move. A campaign that takes an agency weeks to set up goes live in under 30 minutes.

We're a small team building fast. Everyone here uses AI every day, and you will too.

**The Role**

You'll work on the core agent architecture behind Diligent.

Your job will be to build the harness around frontier models: prompt engineering, context engineering, tool design, agent orchestration, evals, memory, model routing, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop systems.

You should be equally comfortable thinking about system design and writing production code.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build AI agent workflows for marketing, growth, reporting, creative analysis, SEO/AEO, lead intelligence, and reputation monitoring.
* Build production-grade harnesses around LLMs using prompts, context, tools, memory, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and human review loops.
* Work on prompt engineering, context engineering, tool calling, workflow decomposition, and agent orchestration.
* Build backend systems that connect with databases, APIs, CRMs, ad platforms, Slack, WhatsApp, dashboards, and internal tools.
* Design systems for ingesting, cleaning, storing, and retrieving business context for AI agents.
* Build evaluation pipelines to test prompt changes, model changes, agent quality, regressions, and edge cases.
* Implement model routing strategies to balance quality, latency, and cost. Improve observability: logs, traces, prompt versions, model outputs, failure analysis, and feedback loops.
* Work closely with product and growth teams to convert messy business workflows into reliable AI systems. Own engineering quality across architecture, code, testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong backend engineering and system design fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, tool calling, or agent frameworks.
* Strong software development fundamentals: clean code, APIs, databases, queues, testing, debugging, version control, and deployment.
* Experience with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar backend stacks.
* Comfort working with Postgres, Redis, vector databases, queues, schedulers, and production services.
* Understanding of structured outputs, JSON schemas, retries, validation, error handling, and deterministic workflows.
* Ability to break ambiguous business workflows into clear technical systems.
* High ownership and comfort working in an early-stage startup environment.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, or similar tools.
* Experience building evals for AI systems.
* Experience with tool servers, workflow engines, agent infrastructure, or automation platforms.
* Experience with marketing/adtech/growth tools such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, Zoho, Shopify, Slack, WhatsApp, or CRMs.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar cloud platforms.
* Experience with observability, tracing, logging, and production monitoring

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Profile:**
Full Stack Developer

**Industry**
: Publishing / Self-Publishing

**Job Location**
: 18. Block E2, BLK Tower Jhandewalan Extension, Metro Station Gate No. 2, New Delhi – 110055

**Employment Type**
: Full-time

ABOUT BOOKLEAF PUBLISHING

BookLeaf Publishing is one of India’s leading independent self-publishing houses, processing 1,200+ books every month across a catalog of 22,000+ titles. We operate across India and the US, run our own warehouse and in-house printing facility in Delhi, and have been featured on Shark Tank India Season 4. Our mission is to make publishing accessible, transparent, and technology-driven for authors everywhere.

We are a small, fast-moving team that punches well above its weight—powered by automation, smart systems, and a bias for shipping. If you thrive in environments where you own outcomes end to end, you’ll fit right in.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Developer who can take ownership of our entire technology stack—from our customer-facing author dashboard and internal operations tools to the AI-powered automations and integrations that keep our publishing engine running. You won’t just write code; you’ll architect systems, make technical decisions, and directly shape how thousands of authors experience BookLeaf.

This role sits at the intersection of product engineering and AI integration. You’ll work on everything from building and improving web applications to setting up intelligent workflows using AI APIs and automation platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

* Build & Scale Web Applications: Design, develop, and maintain our author-facing dashboard, internal tools, and operations software. Take features from concept to production.
* AI & LLM Integration: Integrate AI capabilities into our products and workflows—connecting platforms like OpenAI, building intelligent automations, managing API keys, and ensuring reliable AI-powered features in production.
* Automation & Workflow Engineering: Design and manage automation pipelines using tools like n8n, connecting databases, APIs, payment systems, and third-party services into seamless workflows.
* API Development & Integration: Build and consume RESTful APIs, integrate third-party services (payment gateways, print APIs, distribution platforms), and ensure robust data flow across systems.
* Database & Infrastructure: Manage databases, optimize queries, handle deployments, and ensure our systems are performant, secure, and scalable.
* Technical Leadership: Evaluate architecture decisions, recommend tools and frameworks, mentor junior developers, and establish best practices for code quality and documentation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the founding team to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

* Strong full-stack development experience with proficiency in both frontend (React, Next.js, or similar) and backend (Node.js, Python, or similar) technologies.
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML integration: working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), building AI-powered features, prompt engineering, and understanding how to reliably deploy AI in production applications.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier—including building complex multi-step workflows, handling error scenarios, and connecting to external APIs.
* Solid understanding of databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), API design (REST, webhooks), authentication systems, and cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to own projects end to end: from scoping and architecture through deployment and monitoring.
* Familiarity with Bubble (or willingness to learn it quickly): Our entire operations currently run on Bubble, and while we’re planning a long-term migration to a fully code-based platform, you’ll need to maintain, improve, and build on the existing Bubble dashboard in the interim. Prior Bubble experience is ideal, but we’re equally open to someone who can pick it up fast.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a track record of building systems that are clean, maintainable, and well-documented.
* Strong communication skills: ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical team members and collaborate effectively in a startup environment.

BONUS POINTS

* Experience with payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, Stripe).
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify) and print-on-demand workflows.
* Experience with DevOps practices: CI/CD, containerization, VPS management.
* Understanding of publishing, media, or content industry workflows.
* Prior experience in a startup where you wore multiple hats.

WHY BOOKLEAF?

* Work directly with the founders in a high-impact role where your contributions are visible from day one.
* Shape the technology direction of a fast-growing publishing company at a pivotal stage of its journey.
* Be at the forefront of AI integration in an industry ripe for innovation.
* A culture that values ownership, speed, and building things that matter for real authors.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**Send your resume along with links to your portfolio, GitHub, or any live projects to hr@bookleafpub.in**

* **Please include a brief note on why you’re excited about this role.**

description:
Engineer 3, Business Systems (CPQ)
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**About Team**
 The CRM Technologies Team plays a critical role in optimizing our sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce and Quote\-to\-Cash technologies, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, and operational support needed to effectively manage quoting, pricing, approvals, and downstream business processes.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, CPQ, integrations, and platform operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM ecosystem to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Quote\-to\-Cash solutions.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a CPQ Engineer III to design, build, and support core capabilities in our Configure–Price–Quote (CPQ) stack that power how our GTM teams sell and price MongoDB offerings. As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and support Salesforce solutions across product modeling, pricing, quoting, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Configure and enhance CPQ capabilities including product rules, price rules, bundles, product options, quote templates, discounting, and approval workflows
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and deliver scalable business solutions
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and platform APIs to support related processes
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, contract, and other enterprise platforms
* Participate in technical design, story grooming, sprint planning, testing, code reviews, release management, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across CPQ configuration, pricing logic, automation, integrations, and system performance
* Support documentation, UAT, regression testing, and user enablement to improve adoption and platform reliability
* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery: Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ, utilizing a mix of declarative configuration and custom development (Apex, LWC, and Flow)
* System Architecture: Design and implement robust integrations between CPQ and downstream systems (ERP, Billing, Telemetry) to ensure data integrity across the Lead\-to\-Cash lifecycle
* Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards for code quality by implementing testable, modular solutions and contributing to shared frameworks and CI/CD best practices
* Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing CPQ flows, improving calculator speed and user experience for a global sales force
* Mentorship \& Influence: Lead peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical playbook, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering organization


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform
* Good understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, sales workflows, and Salesforce best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs
* Experience with product modeling, pricing rules, quoting workflows, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, or other enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, version control, and Salesforce release practices
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. **Job Description**
 About the job About Camley Camley is building the agentic infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are leading private equity and infrastructure investment firms, and we are at the forefront of transforming a $55T asset class that still runs on spreadsheets and software built in the 1990s. What Harvey did for legal, we are doing for private markets. We are building the multi\-agent architecture that operates funds end\-to\-end, solving the highest\-stakes problems investment firms face with accuracy and speed. Our agents are not just chatbots \- they move money and execute workflows autonomously. We are backed by top VCs, incl. the first investor in Lovable and one of the most technical AI investors in Silicon Valley responsible for building Uber’s core algorithm. Camley is built by a team from Stanford, Harvard, IIT Delhi, and Penn, with decades of industry experience at McKinsey, SquarePoint, and Deutsche Bank \+ building foundation models for an Accel\-backed startup. About the role We are hiring a founding full\-stack AI engineer. You will build products end\-to\-end and shape agent architecture and technical decisions alongside the CTO. You’ll build the core intelligence layer \- language models for reading documents, a knowledge graph \& vector DB for storing data and relationships, a calculation engine for the fund mathematics and an orchestration layer that coordinates these into workflows that an auditor can sign. You'll own high\-impact features across the stack, from model integration to infrastructure. We are a small team working across London and New York. We are open to remote/hybrid for the right candidate. We are a lean team with a high bar for excellence, and hours will at times be intense as in any high\-growth startup. In return, you get the autonomy to do some of the best work of your life, and a founding team that values openness, empathy, and not taking ourselves too seriously. Strong candidates have: Built products from 0 to 1 5\+ years of experience building production software Strong full\-stack fundamentals across frontend, backend, and infra Proficiency in Python and production experience building LLM systems/agent frameworks High ownership: you do not wait for a spec to start solving a problem Made AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) a core part of how they work Passion for building effective domain\-specific agents Bonus points if you have: Experience in finance or financial services Data\-intensive backend work Early\-stage startup experience Technology stack Typescript/React, Python (FastAPI), Postgres, AWS, and an agent orchestration layer you will help design. Please do not submit AI generated applications.

 We expect you to have a solid foundation in data structures, programming languages, common design patterns, and software engineering best practices.

* Ability to automate solutions to repetitive problems and tasks
* Demonstrative written and verbal communication skills working with audiences with a wide variety of technical expertise
* Passion for learning and using new technologies


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Customer-Facing | Prompt Engineering | AI Automation)
description:
**About This Job**
**MyOperator**
**Location:** 
 Greater Delhi Area, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Software Development,Telecommunications,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About MyOperator
   

  

 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
   

  

 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
   

  

 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction


 Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.
   

  

* Use Case \& Solution Documentation


 Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:Problem statement \& goals.Current vs. proposed conversational flows.Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.
   

  

* Customer Delivery Ownership


 Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.
   

  

* Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design


 Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."
   

  

* Testing, Debugging \& Iteration


 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
   

  

* Integrations \& Technical Coordination


 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.
   

  

 Requirements (Must Have)
   

  

 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).
   

  

 Good to Have (Nice to Have)
   

  

 Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.
   

  

 Working Style \& Traits We Value
   

  

 High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).

title: Application Engineer, Aladdin Product Engineering, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
 At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Application Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global Aladdin Accounting Retail fund operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise\-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. You’ll also help the team explore and adopt emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering and Generative AI, where they can meaningfully improve engineering productivity, operational workflows, or user experience.
   

  

**About Aladdin Accounting**
* Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing commercial product businesses within Aladdin.
* A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments.
* Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations.
* Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and Kafka to manage high\-volume, real\-time data.
* Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business\-critical capabilities.
* Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop robust, high\-performance back\-end systems using Java 21\+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
* Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands\-on approach.
* Build and maintain microservices and event\-driven systems to process and distribute large\-scale financial data with API\-first approach.
* Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real\-time streaming platforms.
* Implement and optimize Redis\-based caching and data stores for low\-latency access patterns.
* Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning.
* Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and design thinking.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI and GenAI capabilities where appropriate to improve software development, operational efficiency, and user experiences, while maintaining strong standards around security, validation, and maintainability.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes.


**Qualifications / Competencies**
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in Java and object\-oriented design.
* Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modelling.
* Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence.
* Hands\-on exposure to Kafka or similar publish\-subscribe systems for real\-time event processing.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming).
* Exposure to Generative AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, or agentic AI patterns.
* Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP).
* Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
* Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis.
* Interest in applying AI capabilities responsibly within enterprise software and engineering workflows.
* Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Engineer - GTM Tech
description:

The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands\-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross\-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high\-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

 Success Measures

* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Platform Engineer** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Candidates should be based out of Delhi NCR / Bhopal)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years total · 3\+ years owning platform architecture or data infrastructure in production
 



**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending, fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



 We are in scale\-up mode \- shipping fast, onboarding customers continuously, and standardizing the platform engineering patterns that compound across every customer and product line.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on engineering role with architectural ownership. You will spend the majority of your time designing and writing code, not running a program office and not managing a team. You will take ambiguous requirements from customer environments \- undocumented schemas, legacy ERP systems, inconsistent data quality and turn them into reliable, repeatable platform capability.
 



 You will operate with a high degree of independence, make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy calls, and be accountable for how the platform performs, scales, and stays up in front of customers.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**1\. Platform Architecture \& System Design** 



* Own the architecture of Sutra.AI’s core platform services \- service boundaries, API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across the stack.
* Translate solution and customer requirements into concrete engineering approaches, reference architectures, and build sequences the wider team can execute against.
* Design for multi\-tenancy, scale, and reuse so that platform capability built for one customer generalizes to the next.
* Proactively challenge architectural gaps, evaluate technical feasibility, and make pragmatic build\-versus\-configure decisions with clear trade\-off reasoning.
* Drive technical decisions through design documents, architecture reviews, and working prototypes rather than opinion.



**2\. Data Infrastructure \& Pipelines** 



* Design, build, and operate ingestion pipelines from diverse customer systems \- ERP, CRM, MES, relational and non\-relational databases, files, and APIs.
* Own batch and streaming data processing, orchestration, transformation layers, and the storage architecture underneath analytics and AI workloads.
* Build data quality, schema\-drift detection, lineage, and reconciliation controls so downstream models and dashboards can be trusted.
* Model relationships between operational systems, workflows, and data sources where documentation does not exist, and formalize what you discover.
* Optimize query performance, storage cost, and pipeline throughput as data volumes and customer count grow.
* Build and maintain the data foundations that AI workloads depend on, including retrieval, embedding, and feature pipelines.



**3\. Security, Governance \& Multi\-Tenancy** 



* Implement tenant isolation, access control, secrets management, and encryption standards across platform and data layers.
* Build the governance controls \- audit trails, retention, PII handling \- required to operate credibly in enterprise and regulated customer environments.
* Partner with engineering leadership to align platform practices to compliance frameworks relevant to our customers.



**4\. Engineering Standards \& Technical Leadership** 



* Establish platform engineering standards, reusable components, internal libraries, and documentation that raise the whole team’s throughput.
* Mentor engineers through design discussions, code review, and pair programming; lead by example on code quality.
* Identify engineering and operational risks early, design mitigation plans, and resolve them with stakeholders rather than only reporting them.
* Collaborate with Implementation, Solutioning, and Product teams so platform decisions stay tied to customer value and delivery timelines.



**Requirements** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6\-10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years owning platform, infrastructure, or data engineering systems in production.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership \- you have designed systems end to end, not only implemented someone else’s design.
* Strong backend engineering skills in Python (and comfort with Node.js/TypeScript services), including APIs, async systems, and distributed architectures.
* Deep data engineering experience: ETL/ELT design, batch and stream processing, orchestration, and warehouse or lakehouse modelling.
* Strong SQL and database engineering \- schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning across relational and NoSQL stores.
* Hands\-on cloud experience (AWS primary; Azure or GCP acceptable) including compute, storage, managed databases, networking, and IAM.
* Working experience with containerization, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership: systems you shipped independently from problem statement to production and then operated.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills across layers \- data quality, application behaviour, infrastructure, and system design.
* Ability to work through ambiguity: undocumented systems, incomplete requirements, and competing priorities across concurrent engagements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in startups or fast\-growth product environments with high ownership and low process overhead.
* Experience building platform or data foundations for AI/ML workloads \- retrieval systems, vector stores, feature or embedding pipelines.
* Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS platform experience.
* Exposure to enterprise system integration (ERP, CRM) and to industrial domains such as manufacturing, supply chain, or production.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2\) and enterprise security review processes.
* Open\-source contributions, published technical writing, or internal platform tooling you built and others adopted.



**Core Technical Competencies** 




**Languages:** 
 Python (primary), SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript; Bash for automation
 



**Data Engineering:** 
 Airflow or equivalent orchestration, dbt, Spark, Kafka or similar streaming, batch and incremental pipeline design
 



**Storage \& Query:** 
 PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, object storage, columnar warehouses, Trino or equivalent query engines
 



**Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) primary; Azure/GCP secondary; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 



**DevOps \& Reliability:** 
 CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, monitoring and alerting, logging and tracing, incident response

* Efficiency: cloud and infrastructure cost per customer as scale increases.



**The Ideal Candidate** 



* Builder\-owner: you take a problem from an ambiguous statement to running a production system without needing constant direction.

* Pragmatic: you optimize for what the business needs now while keeping the door open for what it will need next, and you can tell those apart.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.
