title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

description:

We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Platform Lead with a minimum of 8 years of experience to take technical and architectural ownership of our ServiceNow platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be an excellent developer, a strong solution architect, and a strategic thinker who can identify how ServiceNow can deliver measurable business value.

* Own the technical direction, architecture, stability, security, and overall health of the ServiceNow platform.

* Design scalable, secure, maintainable, and upgrade\-friendly ServiceNow solutions.

* Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow best practices and use out\-of\-the\-box capabilities wherever practical.
* Define and enforce standards for architecture, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and governance.
* Identify technical debt, platform risks, performance issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve user experience, and increase business value.
* Lead complex technical discussions, solution\-design sessions, platform upgrades, and root\-cause analysis.
* Create and maintain clear technical, architecture, integration, and support documentation.
* Guide developers, administrators, internal teams, and implementation partners.


**Required Skills**
* Experience as a ServiceNow Platform Lead, Technical Architect, Solution Architect, Lead Developer, or similar senior role.
* Strong ServiceNow development and scripting skills.
* Proven experience designing and delivering complex ServiceNow solutions.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, integrations, security, data models, performance, testing, release management, and upgrades.
* Ability to understand an unfamiliar ServiceNow environment independently and become productive quickly.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, leadership, and vendors.
* Strong sense of accountability and platform ownership.
* Experience with ITSM, CMDB, Asset Management, App Engine, Service Portal or Employee Center, Automated Test Framework, Discovery, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics and Strategic Portfolio Management.

**Full\-Stack AI Engineer, Titan Capital** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon Sec 67, in office/hybrid \|
 **Experience: 2** 
 \-4 years \|
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About** 




 Titan Capital is a leading early\-stage venture capital firm investing in India's most ambitious startups at the seed stage. With a portfolio spanning 300\+ companies in consumer, fintech, SaaS, healthcare and emerging technologies, Titan partners closely with exceptional founders to build category\-defining companies.
 



 Our investment team builds its own solutions and MVPs \- sourcing engines, portfolio trackers and diligence agents that the firm now depends on daily. We are hiring one go\-getter AI\-native engineer to own data, IT and AI resources at Titan: to develop the solutions the team needs, decide which prototypes merit investment, move them into a secure production environment, and build the architecture that enhances Titan’s AI\-native capabilities.
 



  





**What will you do?** 



* Build solutions in collaboration with the team. In many cases, you will own a problem from the requirement itself as the sole builder. In others, you will take a prototype the team has already built into production, working alongside whoever built it, understanding the intent, and agreeing jointly on what to harden, what to rebuild and what to retire.
* Own the operational foundation end to end: deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, secrets management, role\-based access and audit logging.
* Build the evaluation and guardrail layer. An agent that is correct eighty percent of the time on deal data remains a liability until its accuracy can be measured and bounded.
* Design scalable APIs and data models (Node.js / Express.js, MongoDB) and clear, responsive interfaces (React / Next.js).
* Own production incidents personally, from alert through resolution to post\-mortem.
* Integrate LLMs and AI APIs into production applications: retrieval, agents, tool use, and structured extraction from unstructured documents.
* Work AI\-natively yourself. Coding agents, evals and automation are how we expect this role to ship at the pace of a small team rather than one person.
* Maintain our data posture under India's DPDP Act and under LP security review.
* Work from problem definition rather than a specification. Translate the requirements of the investment and operations teams into technical solutions, and challenge them where the trade\-offs warrant it.
* Raise the technical capability of the team. Review what non\-engineers ship, provide patterns and guardrails, and ensure the team can keep prototyping.
* Study how leading teams are deploying AI, and bring the architectures worth adopting back to Titan Capital.



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* An AI\-native builder. You reach for LLMs, coding agents and automation as a default working method, not as an experiment..
* Demonstrated experience shipping LLM\-based systems into production, with real users depending on them. Fluency in prompt engineering, retrieval design and evaluation. You can distinguish a production\-ready model output from one that is not.
* Backend, where this role sits heaviest. Three plus years of experience building APIs and data models in Node.js / Express.js with MongoDB, working with SQL, and handling messy third‑party data. Job queues, retries, rate limits and schema drift are familiar territory.
* Frontend, React / Next.js. Pixel\-perfect design work is not required. Interfaces that are fast, clear and difficult to misuse are.
* Networking and infrastructure fundamentals. HTTP, DNS, TLS, VPCs, load balancing, authentication flows and latency budgets. You can trace a slow request from browser to database and account for the time.
* Genuine DevOps competence, including hands\-on responsibility for systems running in production.
* A working security instinct. You understand the cost of a credential in a repository, the case for role\-based access, and the response required when a vendor token is compromised. Application security or ethical hacking experience is an advantage.
* Comfort inheriting code you did not write. Some of your work begins as someone else's prototype, and you can read it, respect the intent behind it, and rebuild it constructively.
* An ownership mindset that does not depend on structure around it.
* Strong collaborative skills. You can sit with a team member, extract the real requirement from an imprecise brief, and explain a technical trade\-off without jargon.



  





**Nice to have:** 
 founding engineer experience, internal tooling or data infrastructure, entity resolution and deduplication, exposure to venture capital or private markets.

 Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
 





 This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI\-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
 




  






**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 The Software Engineer role is a full stack engineering position focused on building and maintaining product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript). Engineers in this role contribute to platform capabilities used by consultants and clients in live engagements, working within established patterns and with guidance from senior team members. Contributions span both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users — including the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client\-ready output views.
 





 This is a delivery\-focused role for engineers who are ready to contribute meaningfully across the full stack and grow their ownership over time. The core expectation is shipping well\-tested features within defined specifications, collaborating closely with senior engineers, and developing the habits and judgment that come with working in a production product environment. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, contributing to troubleshooting efforts, and supporting code deployments.
 




  






**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Feature Development
 
* Implement features across backend API logic and React frontend components for assigned Artemis product areas, working from clear specifications and with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to taking features from development through testing and deployment across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, following established patterns for request/response contracts, versioning, and testing. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.



 Frontend and Data Visualization 
 
* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, contributing to marketing analytics interfaces including channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, and model configuration workflows. Follow established component and styling conventions.
* Write database queries and data access logic for Artemis data models, following existing schema and migration patterns. Develop familiarity with the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.



 Quality and Collaboration
 
* Write and maintain tests for backend and frontend code. Ensure new features ship with adequate coverage and do not degrade existing functionality, with support from senior engineers on testing strategy.
* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go\-to\-market\-aligned specialists. Contribute observations and help translate feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across the team and with adjacent stakeholders.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
 
* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.



  






**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical
 
* Proficient in Python for backend development, with exposure to or interest in async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Able to implement features within an established codebase and framework.
* Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production or near\-production context, with foundational understanding of state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
* Familiarity with CSS and comfort working within component libraries and design systems, following established conventions rather than authoring them from scratch.
* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing SQL queries, reading and modifying schemas, and debugging query issues.
* Exposure to data visualization libraries for building chart\-based interfaces is a plus.
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade\-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results\-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced Agile environment.



 Education
 
* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.



 Experience
 
* 2\-3\+ years of experience building full\-stack web applications.


* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
* Experience building web interfaces for data\-heavy or analytics applications, where outputs are used by business users to make commercial decisions, highly preferred.
* Exposure to marketing, media, or commercial data (such as spend, sales, or campaign performance) in any context, including academic or side projects, is a plus.

We are a full\-stack D2C residential solar brand \- designing, installing, maintaining (after\-sales) and financing solar systems for home\-owners across India.
   

  

 In 3 years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

* Featured by TIME Magazine\- as World’s Top Greentech Companies of 2025

* Techcrunch SolarSquare article
* Elevation \- Podcast with SolarSquare Founders
* Startup by IIT Grads Helps Indian Homes Run on Zero Electricity, Earns Rs 200 Crore in Revenues
* The Climate Conversations ft Solar Square
* Elevation Capital \- SolarSquare


**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem.
   

  

 That means: when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain.
   

  

 You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two — still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2–4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end: shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own — not a problem you delivered to.


**What We're Looking For**
* Over 4 years of professional experience in software development, specifically focused on solving large\-scale technical challenges.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Java, GO, Rust, NodeJS etc) with a focus on writing scalable, maintainable, and unit\-tested code.
* Strong command of object\-oriented design, design patterns, and the creation of intuitive class\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading, concurrency, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Deep understanding of relational databases (Postgres) and various NoSQL technologies like HBase, Elasticsearch, or Aerospike, Cassandra
* Comprehensive knowledge of the full software development life cycle on Linux platforms.
* Proven ability to build highly scalable applications that manage complex business logic and massive datasets.
* A proactive, "go\-getter" mindset characterized by high energy and dedication to task ownership.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced startup environments with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.
* A passionate drive to tackle complex, real\-world problems through innovative engineering.
* You've made and defended technical decisions, picked up problems no one assigned, or built things people use that no one asked for.
* Strong fundamentals in your primary stack — concurrency, data modeling, debugging across systems, performance work. We're stack\-agnostic for the right person.
* Experience designing systems with explicit attention to scale, reliability, and cost — not just functional correctness.
* Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to monitor project outcomes and iteratively refine features based on real\-world impact.


 Skills:\- Java, Go Programming (Golang), Rust and NodeJS (Node.js)

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Us:** 




 We are a profitable health\-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product\-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive.
 



  





**\[Expected Compensation Range: ₹35,00,000 – ₹55,00,000 per annum]** 




  





**The Role:** 




 The Permanent Player\-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone\-wolf architect. This is a hands\-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest.
 



  





**Experience Range:** 




 8 to 12 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience.
 



  





**The 6\-Month Trajectory:** 




 ● 
 **Months 1\-2 (Heavy Architecture):** 
 Your focus will be architecting the AWS\-to\-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team.
 



 ●
 **Months 3\-6\+ (The Steady State):** 
 You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role.
 



 You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1\-on\-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery.
 



 You’ll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem.
 



 ● Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep.
 



 ● Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories.
 



 ● Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt.
 



 ● Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5\-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise\-grade engineers.
 



 ● Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap.
 



 ● Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey).
 



 ● Senior\-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus.\*
 



 ● Deep, practical, hands\-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs.
 



 ● Experience integrating complex third\-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes.
 



 ● High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard\-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one.
 



 ● Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS\*, GCP, Azure)

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**Job Title** 
 :
 
 Software Engineer (Full Stack)
 




**Location :** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Years of Experience :** 
 4\-7 Years
 



**Salary** 
 : As per the industry Standards
 



  





  





**What we are Building?** 




 Intellica is a BI \+ AI analytics cloud for Indian hospital chains. Hospital leadership opens it at 8am to see revenue, occupancy, and payor mix across facilities — dense fiscal comparison grids (FTD/MTD/LMTD/LYMTD) that today live in Power BI — and asks follow\-up questions in plain English. Under the hood: one metric registry, a deterministic query compiler over ClickHouse, and an LLM that translates questions into a validated intermediate representation. We are now looking to build a production grade AI native intelligence and insights product from the ground up that will service its first large customer within a few months
 



  





  





**What You'll own?** 




 You are the application engineer on the team — everything from the query engine to the pixel :
 



  




* **The semantic core** 
 : the IR validator, the fiscal time\-intelligence engine (as\-of dates, month\-to\-date comparisons across an Apr–Mar fiscal calendar), and the compiler that turns validated IRs into parameterized ClickHouse SQL. Pure TypeScript functions with exhaustive tests — this is where a subtle date bug becomes a wrong revenue number on a CFO's screen, so we test like it matters



  




* **The API** 
 : a NestJS service — auth/tenant context, report rendering, chat orchestration (SSE streaming), caching, audit logs.



  




* **The frontend** 
 : React \+ TypeScript. Two surfaces: a virtualized pivot grid that renders 40×60 fiscal comparison matrices smoothly with Indian number formatting (₹ Cr/L), and a chat experience with streaming answers, charts, tappable clarifications, and refusals that actually help.



  




* **The LLM plumbing :** 
 structured\-output calls via OpenRouter, prompt versioning, a semantic cache, and the eval harness \+ CI gates that keep accuracy honest. You'll treat the LLM as a component to constrain, not a magic box



  




* **Product decisions :** 
 We have no designer and no PM. You'll make dozens of small UX calls a week for non technical hospital executives, and you'll be right most of the time because you care how it feels



  





  





**What we are looking for ?** 




  




* 4–7 years shipping production web products, with
 **TypeScript across the stack** 
 (Node backend \+ React frontend) as your primary tool for at least the last 2–3 years



  




* You've built at least one
 **data\-heavy product surface** 
 — dashboards, reporting, analytics, admin tools with real tables and real numbers — and you know why "it renders" and "it's trustworthy" are different bars.



  




* **Testing discipline on tricky logic** 
 . You've written the boundary\-case tests nobody asked for (dates, money, pagination, permissions) because you've been burned. You can show us



  




* **Solid SQL** 
 . You can write and reason about analytical queries (GROUP BY, window basics, date ranges) and spot why two queries disagree.



  




* You've
 **used LLM APIs in production or serious side projects** 
 — structured outputs, streaming, retries — and you're pragmatic about them



  




* You work well with
 **AI coding tools** 
 (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) and can be honest about what you verify by hand. Our small team ships at the pace it does because we use these well, with taste



  





  





**Nice to Have** 




 ClickHouse or any OLAP store · NestJS · TanStack Table/Query, Recharts · SSE/streaming UIs · fiscal/timezone/calendar logic · B2B SaaS for non\-technical users · healthcare or fintech domain · pnpm monorepos.
 



  





  





**How we work** 



* Small team, high trust, direct access to the founder.
* Written specs and decision logs over meetings.
* CI gates over heroics.
* We'd rather you push back on the spec than silently build the wrong thing.
* You'll see your work used by hospital leadership within weeks, not quarters.



  





  





**About Prodigy Health** 





 Prodigy Health is an AI\-native healthcare technology company building the data and intelligence layer for modern hospitals. We build two products: CarePro, a patient engagement and conversion platform, and Intellica, a health BI cloud for multi\-unit hospital analytics. Our platforms live with leading enterprise hospital groups across India, running mission\-critical operations at scale. We're a small, fast\-moving team that ships real products into real hospitals — where reliability, security, and data integrity genuinely matter.
 




  






 We serve multi\-unit hospital groups running dozens of facilities on a single platform. That means everything we build has to be
 
**multi\-tenant, secure, and scalable by default** 

 . The core platform is already live on MERN and in production with enterprise hospital chains. We're now scaling the architecture and deepening AI across the product.

title: AI Engineer-Agentic AI-Orchestration And Azure AI Foundry-Full‑Stack-Azure‑Native
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The AI Engineer is responsible for building, deploying, and operating production\-grade AI and Agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on implementing LLM\-powered applications, orchestration and multi\-agent workflows, and secure API\-driven integrations using Azure AI Foundry and Azure\-native services (compute, storage, messaging, data, security, and observability).
   

  

 The role works across the
 **full AI lifecycle** 
 —from system design and development to production operations—ensuring solutions are
 **secure, scalable, observable, and governed** 
 . The AI Engineer partners closely with Engineering Leads, architects, data science teams, and platform/security stakeholders to translate AI use cases into
 **reliable, enterprise‑ready systems** 
 , not isolated proofs of concept.
   

  

 A key expectation of the role is to embed
 **evaluation, quality monitoring, and runtime security** 
 into AI systems, including the use of
 **LLM‑as‑a‑Judge** 
 patterns and alignment to
 **agent lifecycle governance and runtime protection controls** 
 (e.g., Agent 365–aligned environments).
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
 Build Agentic AI Solutions using Azure AI Foundry (Core): Build and evolve AI applications and agents leveraging Azure AI Foundry\-aligned capabilities used in the enterprise toolchain
   

  

 Develop Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems (Core): Implement
 **orchestration layers** 
 to coordinate tools/agents across multi\-step tasks, including
 **multi\-agent workflows** 
 for specialized sub\-tasks and coordinated execution.
   

  

 Full‑Stack Engineering \+ API Development (Core): Build
 **end\-to\-end AI experiences** 
 (UI where applicable), backend services, and integration layers. Design and implement
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices that expose AI/agent capabilities securely and reliably.
   

  

 Serverless \& Asynchronous Processing with Azure Functions (Core): Build services using
 **Azure Functions** 
 , including
 **Durable Functions** 
 (or equivalent) for long\-running and stateful orchestration patterns.
   

  

 Messaging / Queues for Workflow Reliability (Core): Use queue/event\-driven patterns (e.g., messaging, pub/sub) to decouple services and improve reliability of multi\-step AI pipelines and orchestration flows.
   

  

 Data Engineering Foundations: ADLS \+ Retrieval (Core): Work with
 **ADLS** 
 \-style data lake patterns for ingestion, storage, and processing to support AI workloads and grounding.
   

  

 Use Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services Where Appropriate (Core: Leverage
 **Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services** 
 capabilities as part of end\-to\-end AI solutions.
   

  

 Vector Databases \& Knowledge Stores (Core): Implement vector retrieval using enterprise options such as
 **Azure AI Search** 
 and/or other vector DB patterns (e.g., Cosmos DB / PostgreSQL pgvector / Redis) based on operational needs.
   

  

 Continuous Evaluation using LLM\-as\-a\-Judge (Core): Implement evaluation pipelines for LLM/agent outputs, including
 **LLM\-as\-a\-Judge** 
 patterns and structured scoring/assessment approaches where appropriate.
   

  

 Agent Lifecycle Governance with Agent 365 (A365\) Awareness (Core): Build solutions that align with enterprise lifecycle management and governance patterns such as:
   

  

* 
+ Agent registry / inventory expectations
+ Access controls and telemetry/observability requirements
+ Monitoring and operational controls at “agent scale


 Runtime Security / Runtime Protection (Core): Implement and support
 **runtime protection** 
 expectations for agentic solutions, and participate in controls aligned to:
   

  

* 
+ Runtime protection
+ Access controls (e.g., Entra ID patterns)
+ Threat detection and monitoring expectations


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
* This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into real, reliable, and scalable systems—not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
 Core Software Engineering (Required)
   

  

* Strong hands\-on development in Python / C\# / TypeScript/JavaScript (or similar).
* Experience building API\-driven services and integrating distributed systems. \[Build agen...65 Copilot \| SharePoint], \[Agents in...65 Copilot \| SharePoint]
* Strong understanding of non\-functional requirements: reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost.


 Azure \& Platform Engineering
   

  

* Hands‑on experience with Azure AI Foundry for delivering enterprise GenAI solutions in an enterprise context.
* Experience building serverless and asynchronous workloads using Azure Functions (including Durable Functions or equivalent).
* Experience using queues and event‑driven messaging for decoupled, reliable workflows.
* Experience working with ADLS for data ingestion, storage, and processing.
* Experience using Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services as part of AI solutions.


 Azure Functions \+ Queues/Eventing (Required)

 Vector Databases (Required)

 LLM\-as\-a\-Judge Evaluation (Required)

 Agent 365 (A365\) \+ Governance Alignment (Required)

 Runtime Security / Runtime Protection (Required)

 Nice to Have

**Detailed Responsibilities:**
 AI \& Agentic Solution Engineering
   

  

* Build and evolve AI applications and agents using Azure AI Foundry and Azure‑native services.

 Full‑Stack \& Backend Development
   

  

* Develop backend services, APIs, and supporting components for AI solutions.

 Data, Retrieval \& Knowledge Systems

 Evaluation, Monitoring \& Quality

 Security, Governance \& Operations
   

  

* Build AI systems aligned to runtime security and governance expectations, including access controls and monitoring.
